established: Complete PvM total-damage/resistance bodies independently mitigate poison rate and frame length. Poison length uses poison-length resistance and passive poison pierce, with no max-poison-resistance stat; rate uses ordinary poison resistance and its maximum. Neither lane receives flat MDR or absorption.

The declared expansion game difficulty penalty applies to both player poison resistance and poison-length resistance. Positive player length resistance caps75; positive rate resistance caps75+max-res up to95. Negative values floor-100. NPC positive resistance can reach immunity100; passive pierce does not break that lane when its initial resistance is100or more.

Poison-resist shrine zeroes length before resistance, without requiring the rate lane to become zero. Nonzero resistance on large raw rate values above1048576 uses the full percentage helper’s early division; zero resistance bypasses that helper and retains the raw value. Ordinary source frame lengths here multiply before division.
limits: Complete source total-damage, resistance and percentage bodies execute with declared stats, room/world, classification, state, difficulty and event services. NPCs here are ordinary non-hireling/non-prime-evil actors; attacks are PvM, without cooperative PvP adaptation. No modern sunder, global event queue, item stat projection or final poison application is certified.

Raw rates/frame lengths are declared prepared packets; this does not exercise skill/item poison preparation or rolls. The selected source poison shrine is supplied as a state service. Native global versus per-monster difficulty context, exact item pierce/length projection and modern executable equivalence remain separate.

Existing aggregate total/duration producers can round differently from per-frame integer rate mitigation. This fixture prepares their deliberate migration; no Poison Javelin handler or changed mitigation caller is enabled here.
